residualRisks: Linear qualification needs a live host attestation collected by the lead; without it the release cannot be cut and that stays a visible blocker.
The first adopter's git snapshot reader is characterized against native capture only where native capture is available locally.
Coordination remains host behaviour performed by the lead; there is no session-messaging abstraction, so delivery limits of a host are handled by protocol, not code.
A check whose argv names no paths is classified as base-broken by the base re-run alone.
